def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    idx = pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id')

    # --- Позиции: событие известно, только если покупка (ts) произошла до seed_time ---
    items = items[items['ts'] < seed_time]
    items = items[items['product_id'].isin(set(entity_ids))]

    merged = items.merge(
        orders[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp',
                'order_approved_at', 'order_delivered_carrier_date',
                'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']],
        on='order_id', how='left'
    )
    merged = merged[merged['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)

    # --- Отзывы: учитываем только те, что уже существуют на seed_time ---
    rev = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time][['order_id', 'review_score']]

    # --- Платежи: только по заказам, совершённым до seed_time ---
    pay = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time][['order_id', 'payment_value',
                                                'payment_installments', 'payment_type']]

    def empty_row(cols):
        return pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=idx, columns=cols)

    if merged.empty:
        cols = ['total_orders', 'total_items', 'total_sales', 'total_freight',
                'avg_price', 'avg_freight', 'avg_total_value',
                'avg_delivery_days', 'delayed_rate', 'delayed_count',
                'delivered_count', 'canceled_like_rate',
                'avg_review_score', 'count_reviews', 'neg_review_count',
                'orders_90d', 'orders_180d', 'sales_90d',
                'days_since_last_order', 'days_since_first_order',
                'n_sellers', 'avg_price_std', 'avg_installments',
                'share_credit_card', 'avg_payment_value']
        return empty_row(cols)

    merged['total_value'] = merged['price'] + merged['freight_value']

    delivered = merged['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                (merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)
    merged['delivery_days'] = np.where(
        delivered,
        (merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] - merged['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    merged['is_delayed'] = np.where(
        delivered & merged['order_estimated_delivery_date'].notna(),
        (merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] > merged['order_estimated_delivery_date']).astype(float),
        np.nan
    )
    bad_status = merged['order_status'].isin(['canceled', 'unavailable']).astype(float)
    merged['is_bad'] = bad_status

    horizon_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    horizon_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)

    in_90 = merged['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= horizon_90
    in_180 = merged['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= horizon_180

    agg = merged.groupby('product_id').agg(
        total_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        total_items=('order_id', 'count'),
        total_sales=('price', 'sum'),
        total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        avg_total_value=('total_value', 'mean'),
        price_std=('price', 'std'),
        avg_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
        delayed_count=('is_delayed', 'sum'),
        delivered_count=('delivery_days', 'count'),
        bad_count=('is_bad', 'sum'),
        orders_90d=('order_id', lambda s: s[merged.loc[s.index, 'order_purchase_timestamp'] >= horizon_90].nunique()),
        orders_180d=('order_id', lambda s: s[merged.loc[s.index, 'order_purchase_timestamp'] >= horizon_180].nunique()),
        sales_90d=('price', lambda s: s[merged.loc[s.index, 'order_purchase_timestamp'] >= horizon_90].sum()),
        n_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
        last_order=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'max'),
        first_order=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'min'),
    )

    agg['delayed_rate'] = agg['delayed_count'] / agg['delivered_count'].replace(0, np.nan)
    agg['canceled_like_rate'] = agg['bad_count'] / agg['total_items'].replace(0, np.nan)

    # --- Отзывы, существующие на seed_time ---
    rev_merge = merged[['product_id', 'order_id']].merge(rev, on='order_id', how='inner')
    if not rev_merge.empty:
        rev_agg = rev_merge.groupby('product_id').agg(
            avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
            count_reviews=('review_score', 'count'),
            neg_review_count=('review_score', lambda x: (x <= 2).sum())
        )
        agg = agg.join(rev_agg, how='left')
    else:
        agg['avg_review_score'] = np.nan
        agg['count_reviews'] = 0.0
        agg['neg_review_count'] = 0.0

    # --- Платежи по заказам, известным на seed_time ---
    pay_merge = merged[['product_id', 'order_id']].merge(pay, on='order_id', how='inner')
    if not pay_merge.empty:
        pay_merge['is_credit'] = (pay_merge['payment_type'] == 'credit_card').astype(float)
        pay_agg = pay_merge.groupby('product_id').agg(
            avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
            avg_payment_value=('payment_value', 'mean'),
            credit_rate=('is_credit', 'mean'),
        )
        agg = agg.join(pay_agg, how='left')
    else:
        agg['avg_installments'] = np.nan
        agg['avg_payment_value'] = np.nan
        agg['credit_rate'] = np.nan

    agg['days_since_last_order'] = (seed_time - agg['last_order']).dt.days
    agg['days_since_first_order'] = (seed_time - agg['first_order']).dt.days
    agg = agg.drop(columns=['last_order', 'first_order'])

    features = features.join(agg, how='left')
    features = features.fillna(0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0)
    features = features.reindex(idx).fillna(0.0)
    return features.astype(float)
